g.text: Development coverage: what short Q gaps can recover
Dashed line: 90% goal, not an established outcome. All policies retain weather, soil and calendar requirements.
First two panels use all requested origins; last uses approved targets above gradient-training q95.
Combined route is a structural upper bound pending filler/model qualification; it changes the information used.
Counts describe potential input support, not generated forecasts or forecast skill; repeated windows are not independent events.
